(I)--(अतिबाहु) a son of Priyavrata; king of साल्मलिद्वीप; father of seven sons who were founders of seven kingdoms--श्वेत, Harita, जीमूत, Rohita, Vaidyuta, मानस, and Suprabha. Br. II. १४. १२, ३२-4; वा. ३१. १७; ३३. 9, १२; Vi.
(II)--(भार्गव)--a sage of the epoch of III सावर्ण Manu. Br.
(III)--a sage of the XI epoch of Manu. Vi.
--a R. in the भद्रा country. वा. ४३. २७.
(I)--the construction of small ponds at the auspicious time; the same prescription for excavating तडागस् (tanks). M. ५८. 1, ५१.
(II)--one of the ten पीठस् for images with two mekhalas. M. २६२. 6, 8. [page३-190+ ३५]
